tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search tools, services and funding programmes for African founders. Filter by country, category, funding phase or free tier. Each result says which countries it works in, when to use it, when to skip it, and the local catch.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Everything the directory records about one tool or funding programme: pricing, countries, setup time, use-when, skip-when, the local note and the verification date. Use after search_tools, with the slug from a result.

tools.name: search_startups
tools.description: Search African companies by sector, country, funding stage, founder or investor. Returns founders, disclosed funding, named investors and headquarters. Where a company has shut down or been acquired, the description says so.

tools.name: get_startup
tools.description: Everything the directory records about one African company: founders, funding stage, disclosed raise, named investors, valuation, headquarters and current status.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category with its slug, the phase it belongs to and how many entries it holds. Call this first when you need a valid 'category' value for search_tools, or to see what the directory covers before answering that it does not cover something.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Every category with its slug, the phase it belongs to and how many entries it holds. Call this first when you need a valid 'category' value for search_tools, or…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
